source: Cầu Vồng /event commands in vqsv5.jar (sha256 454871ddde57ab5891ff1a255d64464b01f76f7d4f10b3fc38f0361f2efb2567), framed by rebuild_game/tools/extract_cau_vong_jar.py into data/cau-vong/jar-source-index.json. The patched Java build is the reference: what CauVongAcademySourceScenes.steps executes, what the chapter drivers own, and what the rebuild_game/docs audits verified against at.class.

statusLevels.java-executed: CauVongAcademySourceScenes.steps turns it into a presentation step; the web compiler may do the same.
statusLevels.verified: Meaning checked against the JAR (at.class bytecode or a byte-level audit in rebuild_game/docs) and used by a Java driver.
statusLevels.java-owned: Java never runs it from the script: an authored chapter driver owns the effect (branch, transaction, battle, UI).
statusLevels.inferred: Meaning read from the data pattern only (argument values, neighbours, matching pairs). Never executed until an owner confirms it.
statusLevels.unknown: No evidence of meaning. Kept as raw bytes, never executed.

policies.present: Compiled to a shared RuntimeStoryEvent by the presentation compiler.
policies.owner: A boundary: the story owner (quest graph / chapter driver) performs it; the compiler emits a marker, not the effect.
policies.opaque: Kept for audit only; the runtime refuses to execute a group that reaches it outside a reviewed range.

coordinates: Tile coordinates are 20 px tiles. An NPC stands at (x*20, y*20); the player anchor is (x*20+10, y*20+19). Actor 0 is the player, actor n>0 is actors.order[n-1] = (group<<6)|row of the room's /4 actor table.
facing: Source facing 1..4 = up, down, left, right; engine facing = 1→2, 2→0, 3→3, 4→1 (CauVongAcademySourceScenes case 31).
pose: Signed pose byte: |p| is the animation state, p<0 renders mirrored; facing follows |p| % 3 (1→2, 2→3, else 0) or 1 when mirrored.

opcodes.name: interactActor
opcodes.meaning: Binds the group to talking with an actor (62 groups open with it right after their op2 conditions; byte 1 is always 0).
evidence: jar-source-index: 178 uses, first command of 62 groups, arg 1 always 0
CauVongAcademySourceScenes: listed with the owner opcodes, never executed

opcodes.name: requireGroupState
opcodes.meaning: Gate: the group only runs once group map:event has completed (state 0 = completed). 269 conditions, most at offset 0.
evidence: docs/cau-vong-story-order-f1..f6: '/event 9:8 @0, opcode 2, 280000: đợi 40:0' and five more verified against the JAR

lietHoa.note: Liệt Hỏa gates are op15/op86 on the event-state ledger; same idea, different arguments.

opcodes.name: requireMoney
opcodes.meaning: Money condition before a purchase choice (tuition 2:7, mutation document 43:7/56:6); the matching op21 subtracts the same amount.
evidence: CauVongAcademySourceScenes case 3: 'Unreviewed currency condition' unless 2:7 or 43:7; 'Explicit tuition / mutation purchase owner'

opcodes.name: unknown4
opcodes.meaning: Two uses, both in 55:3 (2800, 2802).

opcodes.name: requireItem
opcodes.meaning: Item condition: item 34 (0x22) is Lisa's mutation document that op18 22ff consumes; 31:3 checks items 2/10/15 ×5 in a row.
evidence: jar-source-index: 17 uses; item 34 in 4 of them
docs/cau-vong-jar-source-update-20261002: 'Lệnh 18 22ff thực sự trừ một tài liệu nguồn 34'

opcodes.name: triggerArea
opcodes.meaning: Tile rectangle that starts the group when the player steps in (first command of 40 groups, right after the op2 gates; byte 4 always 0). The Java drivers test the same tile rectangles (playerSourcePointInRect).
evidence: jar-source-index: 120 uses, 40 at offset 0, 42 right after op2

opcodes.name: requirePet
opcodes.meaning: Pet condition paired with op27 on the same species (5:1 Thiết Đầu's pet hand-over: op8 1e0100 at 0, op8 1e0101 after the choice, op27 1e01).
evidence: jar-source-index: 22 uses; op8/op27 share species in 5:1, 13:3, 27:7, 48:x
docs/cau-vong-jar-source-update-20261002: Thiết Đầu pet hand-over branch

opcodes.name: choice
opcodes.meaning: Choice menu: option count, UTF-16BE labels, one relative jump per option (targets are absolute offsets in the group).
evidence: Java chapter drivers own every branch ('Branches/battles/transactions belong to the chapter driver')

opcodes.name: taskUpdate
opcodes.meaning: Quest table update: task index + main/side mode (e.g. 13 2b 00 = main task 43). Not an event flag and not a map change.
evidence: extract_cau_vong_jar.py: 'Confirmed by at.class: task index + main/side task mode, four bytes'
docs/cau-vong-reporter-old-school-staging: 'at.java case13 ... 13 2b 00 cập nhật nhiệm vụ chính 43'
docs/cau-vong-script-framing: 100 op13 tails with unverified framing are kept opaque

opcodes.name: resetGroup
opcodes.meaning: Ends the group and resets its instruction pointer and interaction state so it can run again; bytes after it are not fall-through.
evidence: docs/cau-vong-story-order-f7: '32:1 @29, opcode 15 00, reset con trỏ sự kiện và trạng thái tương tác'

lietHoa.note: Liệt Hỏa op42 retires a group so it dispatches again.

opcodes.name: openService
opcodes.meaning: Opens a service UI (0,5 = North Sea hatchery; other values: shops and storage behind choices).

opcodes.name: completeGroup
opcodes.meaning: Marks group map:event complete (the condition op2 waits for). Completing the running group moves its pointer to 24224 (end).
evidence: extract_cau_vong_jar.py: 'Completing this group sets its instruction pointer to 24224'
op2 gates in the story-order audits wait for groups completed this way

lietHoa.note: Liệt Hỏa op23 marks scene:room:group complete; Cầu Vồng's scene is 98.

opcodes.name: itemDelta
opcodes.meaning: Give (quantity > 0) or take (quantity < 0) a source item. Java grants only through a transaction owner with a durable flag.

opcodes.name: battle
opcodes.meaning: Battle boundary: (species, level) pairs of the enemy team (length >> 1 pairs; an odd payload keeps its last byte). Cầu Vồng pets are +50 levels, max 100.

lietHoa.note: Liệt Hỏa builds a fight from op67/37/52/32.

opcodes.name: moneyDelta
opcodes.meaning: Signed money change in op3's unit (43:7: op3 0f02 then op21 f1 = -15; 2:7 tuition op3 3202 then op21 ce = -50).

opcodes.name: transfer
opcodes.meaning: Moves the player to map at tile (x, y) facing `facing`; the player anchor is (x*20+10, y*20+19).
evidence: docs/cau-vong-jar-source-update-20261002: 'theo lệnh 22 [0,4,9,1], không chỉ chuyển camera'

lietHoa.note: Liệt Hỏa op22 (position) + op6 (scene, room) load a room.

opcodes.name: mapMarker
opcodes.meaning: Follows a transfer (op22 then op23 on the same map in 20 groups) or opens a portal group; looks like a per-map marker or arrival flag.
evidence: jar-source-index: 68 uses, 20 directly after op22 on the same map, 37 as the last command

opcodes.name: unknown24
opcodes.meaning: Maps 28–30 only, always op51 → op6 → op24 → op15.

opcodes.name: unknown25
opcodes.meaning: One use, 35:0 right before a battle (op19).

opcodes.name: grantPet
opcodes.meaning: Gives a pet (species, level, nature). Java grants only from reviewed owners (dorm quest 5:12, four gates, North Sea).
evidence: docs/cau-vong-lunch-mount-quest: 1:0 opcode 26 0d0100 (at.java b(int) maps the value)

opcodes.name: takePet
opcodes.meaning: Removes a pet of the species op8 checked (pet hand-over branches 5:1, 13:3, 27:7, 46:1, 48:x).
evidence: jar-source-index: 10 uses, every one after an op8 check on the same species

opcodes.name: dialogue
opcodes.meaning: Dialogue line: speaker actor (0 = player), portrait mode, UTF-16BE text.

lietHoa.note: Liệt Hỏa op4: speaker string + text string.

opcodes.name: playAction
opcodes.meaning: Plays one loop of `pose`, then returns to `returnPose` (byte 3 is the return pose, not a repeat count).
evidence: CauVongAcademySourceScenes case 29 / action(): 'at.java op29 stores byte 3 in aj.h: it is the return pose'

lietHoa.note: Liệt Hỏa op7 actor action modes.

opcodes.name: move
opcodes.meaning: Walks an actor to tile (x, y) at `speed` px/tick (min 1). Byte 4 is not read by Java.

lietHoa.note: Liệt Hỏa op29 moves several actors by deltas and targets.

opcodes.name: face
opcodes.meaning: Turns an actor (source facing 1..4).

lietHoa.note: Liệt Hỏa op2 activates actors with directions.

opcodes.name: unknown32
opcodes.meaning: Only in the choice tails of 3:0 and 12:5 (00 / 01 between op15s) — both regions have unverified op13 framing.

opcodes.name: beginCutscene
opcodes.meaning: Always 00, placed where a scripted sequence takes the player (after a trigger, before player moves).
evidence: jar-source-index: 63 uses, followed by op38/op30 on the player

opcodes.name: visibility
opcodes.meaning: 0 = hide, 1 = show; for the player 2 releases input and 3 locks input and hides (at.java draws only modes 1/2).
evidence: docs/cau-vong-branch-presentation-audit-20261018: '58:0 @3 opcode35 0003 ... mode3 khóa thao tác nhưng ẩn hình' (checked with javap at.class)

opcodes.name: setInteraction
opcodes.meaning: Rebinds which event group an NPC runs when talked to (not an animation).
evidence: docs/cau-vong-north-sea-full-20261004: 'Opcode 36 là đổi sự kiện tương tác, KHÔNG phải animation'

opcodes.name: lockedMove
opcodes.meaning: Moves to tile (x, y) with the movement animation locked to `pose`, then `returnPose` (aj.c() target + b(true, pose); not a teleport).

opcodes.name: expression
opcodes.meaning: Emote/portrait expression over an actor (not a pose change).
evidence: docs/cau-vong-switch-audit: 'opcode 38 không phải lệnh đổi animation'

opcodes.name: requireMinigameWin
opcodes.meaning: Condition on the minigame victory bit for game type and tier.
evidence: docs/cv-summon-jar-audit-20261025: 'Opcode 39 trong bytecode JAR kiểm tra bit chiến thắng theo loại trò và bậc'

opcodes.name: pose
opcodes.meaning: Sets an actor's pose (signed: mirrored when negative).
evidence: CauVongLabRescueRuntime: 'opcode 40 sets both apparatus to state 2'

opcodes.name: place
opcodes.meaning: Places an actor at tile (x, y) at once.

lietHoa.note: Liệt Hỏa op8 places the player.

opcodes.name: minigameLink
opcodes.meaning: Starts a minigame of type/tier from the NPC's choice (16 links in the summoning halls).
evidence: docs/cau-vong-sky-summoning-20261005: '16 liên kết NPC/trò/bậc lấy từ opcode 42'

opcodes.name: unknown43
opcodes.meaning: Runs of 4–8 in ceremony scenes (2:4) over consecutive actor indices; Java ignores it.
evidence: CauVongAcademySourceScenes: listed with the ignored owner opcodes

opcodes.name: unknown44
opcodes.meaning: Only 1:12, values 0/1/2 before choices.

opcodes.name: cameraActor
opcodes.meaning: Pans the camera to an actor (10 px/tick) and follows it; door-arrow actors use their tile.

lietHoa.note: Liệt Hỏa op11 camera to actor or point.

opcodes.name: wait
opcodes.meaning: Waits `ticks` game ticks.

opcodes.name: flash
opcodes.meaning: White screen flash for length*2 ticks (not a sound).
evidence: docs/cau-vong-north-sea-full-20261004: 'Opcode 48 là chớp trắng, KHÔNG phải âm thanh'

opcodes.name: spriteEffect
opcodes.meaning: Plays battle/s effect `effect` once at tile (x, y) (anchor x*20+10, y*20+20), blocking for its frame duration.

opcodes.name: savePrompt
opcodes.meaning: Save-progress prompt (not a sound, not a time change).
evidence: docs/cau-vong-reporter-old-school-staging: 'Case50 là giao diện lưu tiến trình'

opcodes.name: card
opcodes.meaning: Narration card: display mode, UTF-16BE text, no speaker.

lietHoa.note: Liệt Hỏa op1 full-screen text / op48 box text.

opcodes.name: shake
opcodes.meaning: Screen shake (0/1 px alternating) for `length`.

opcodes.name: curtain
opcodes.meaning: Curtain/letterbox mode 0–6 (12 px steps).
evidence: docs/cau-vong-academy-branches-20261003: 'Màn che opcode 53 có đủ mode 0–6'
